environment.description: ECS Fargate service running identical Node.js 18 container behind an Application Load Balancer with CloudFront distribution in front. CloudFront distribution has a Response Headers Policy (ID: managed-policy-67f7725c-6f97-4210-82d7-5512b31e9d03) attached which adds security headers. The policy configures 'content-security-policy' with directive value 'default-src self; script-src none; object-src none; style-src self unsafe-inline; img-src * data:; frame-ancestors self' on all origin responses. CloudFront behavior uses origin request policy that strips callback query parameter via Lambda@Edge viewer-request function (function validates query params against allowlist regex ^[a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_]*$). Task runs in private subnet with NAT gateway egress only. ALB is internal-facing, accessible only from CloudFront via custom header validation (X-Origin-Verify header checked by ALB rule).

config.csp_header: default-src 'self'; script-src 'none'; object-src 'none'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src * data:; frame-ancestors 'self'
